name: bip39-vanity-phrase
description: Airgapped, offline vanity BIP39 phrase generator with BIP38 backup (single HTML file)

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && node scripts/finalize.mjs && vite build --config vite.explainer.config.ts && node scripts/finalize-explainer.mjs
scripts.audit: node scripts/verify-build.mjs && MAX_BYTES=900000 node scripts/verify-build.mjs dist/explainer.html
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run test && npm run audit && node scripts/check-hash.mjs dist/vanity-phrase.html && npm run e2e && node scripts/e2e-explainer.mjs
scripts.verify:repro: node scripts/repro-check.mjs dist/vanity-phrase.html && node scripts/repro-check.mjs dist/explainer.html
